Package dao

Class ConciergeDAO

java.lang.Object
dao.ConciergeDAO
public class ConciergeDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) for all Concierge-related database operations in the MIRAGE system.

This class is the sole layer responsible for reading from and writing to the concierge table. Concierge staff are scoped to a single hotel; this association is stored as a foreign key and is respected by the application-level hotel-matching constraint in ExperienceDAO.

Responsibilities

  • Insert new concierge staff records (insertConcierge(Concierge))
  • Delete a concierge by ID (deleteConcierge(int))
  • Retrieve all concierge staff (getAllConcierges())
  • Retrieve concierge staff filtered by hotel (getConciergesByHotel(int))

  • Method Details

    • insertConcierge

      public void insertConcierge(Concierge concierge) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new concierge record into the concierge table.

      The concierge_id is auto-generated by the database (IDENTITY) and is not written back to the concierge object by this method.

      SQL executed:

      
   INSERT INTO concierge (full_name, hotel_id) VALUES (?, ?)
      Parameters:
      concierge - the Concierge to persist; must have a non-null fullName and a valid, existing hotelId
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the hotel ID does not exist (FK violation) or a database error occurs

    • deleteConcierge

      public void deleteConcierge(int conciergeId) throws SQLException
      Deletes a concierge record from the concierge table by primary key.

      Warning: If this concierge is referenced by any existing reservation_experience row, the delete will fail due to a foreign key constraint. The UI should communicate this risk to staff.

      SQL executed:

      
   DELETE FROM concierge WHERE concierge_id = ?
      Parameters:
      conciergeId - the ID of the concierge to delete; must be positive
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the concierge is still referenced by experience records (FK constraint violation) or a database error occurs

    • getAllConcierges

      public List<Concierge> getAllConcierges() throws SQLException
      Retrieves all concierge staff records from the database.

      Each row is mapped to a Concierge instance with conciergeId set via Concierge.setConciergeId(int).

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT * FROM concierge
      Returns:
      a List of all Concierge objects; empty if none exist
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getConciergesByHotel

      public List<Concierge> getConciergesByHotel(int hotelId) throws SQLException
      Retrieves all concierge staff assigned to a specific hotel.

      Used for filtering the concierge list by hotel when needed.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT * FROM concierge WHERE hotel_id = ?
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID of the hotel to filter by; must be positive
      Returns:
      a List of Concierge objects at that hotel; empty if the hotel has no assigned concierge staff
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query
